themes_detail.label: Street Lights Darkening Across District
themes_detail.summary: Street light complaints surged to 18 THIS WEEK compared to a 9.8-per-week average over the prior 8 weeks—an 85% spike (z-score: 4.45)—raising concerns about pedestrian safety and crime prevention in Riverdale/Fieldston neighborhoods after dark.
evidence: 18 street light condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 9.8 per-week baseline (8-week average)
Z-score of 4.45 indicates statistically significant spike
Community board has repeatedly requested traffic and pedestrian safety improvements (long-standing budget request)
reporting_angles: Interview residents about safety concerns during evening commutes and nighttime walking
Obtain DEP maintenance schedules to determine if repairs are delayed or if a specific neighborhood corridor is affected
Cross-reference with crime data to see if poorly lit areas correlate with reported incidents

themes_detail.label: Smoking/Vaping Complaint Explosion
themes_detail.summary: Smoking and vaping complaints skyrocketed to 11 LAST WEEK versus a 1.9-per-week baseline—a 487% spike (z-score: 4.04)—suggesting either a new enforcement effort, a concentrated problem location, or a shift in resident tolerance.
evidence: 11 smoking/vaping complaints LAST WEEK vs. 1.9 per-week average (8-week baseline)
487% increase with z-score of 4.04 indicates highly anomalous spike
No prior Reddit or local news coverage, suggesting this is a newly emerging pattern
reporting_angles: Investigate whether complaints cluster in specific venues (parks, transit hubs, residential buildings) or are dispersed
Interview NYPD/Parks Enforcement to determine if recent patrols or citations drove the spike
Contact anti-smoking advocates to assess whether resident vigilance has increased or if a genuine violation hotspot has emerged

themes_detail.label: Dead Trees and Root Damage Surge
themes_detail.summary: Dead/dying tree complaints exploded to 5 TWO WEEKS AGO versus a 0.1-per-week baseline—a 3900% spike (z-score: 14.74, highest severity)—alongside root/sewer/sidewalk damage complaints at 1500% above baseline, signaling potential infrastructure stress or environmental damage.
evidence: 5 dead/dying tree complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.1 per-week average (highest z-score: 14.74)
4 root/sewer/sidewalk damage complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.2 per-week baseline (z-score: 8.66)
Converging infrastructure concerns suggest possible localized environmental or construction event
Community board has requested park reconstruction/upgrades repeatedly (recurring budget request)
reporting_angles: Map the geographic concentration of tree and root damage complaints to identify if a single neighborhood or street corridor is affected
Contact NYC Parks to determine if recent storm damage, construction, or utility work triggered die-off
Interview residents about sidewalk buckling, tripping hazards, and whether tree removals have disrupted canopy cover or property values
Investigate whether contractor activity (DOB permits show 323 filings, including 208 alterations) may have damaged underground roots

themes_detail.label: Dead Animal Cleanup Backlog
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints jumped to 5 LAST WEEK compared to a 0.8-per-week baseline—a 567% spike (z-score: 3.9)—indicating either a sanitation backlog or an animal health crisis in the district.
evidence: 5 dead animal complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.8 per-week baseline (567% increase)
Z-score of 3.9 indicates statistically significant anomaly
Unsanitary conditions remain in top 6 complaint categories overall (519 over 90 days)
reporting_angles: Contact Sanitation Department to determine removal timelines and whether staffing is adequate
Consult NYC Parks and Animal Care and Control about potential wildlife die-offs or seasonal die patterns
Interview residents about health and quality-of-life impacts, particularly near parks or commercial areas

themes_detail.label: Asbestos Reports Resurge
themes_detail.summary: Asbestos complaints spiked to 3 THREE WEEKS AGO versus a 0.4-per-week baseline—a 700% increase (z-score: 5.42)—raising potential building safety concerns given the district's older housing stock and ongoing construction activity.
evidence: 3 asbestos complaints 3 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.4 per-week baseline (700% spike, z-score: 5.42)
DOB filings show 323 permits filed in last 90 days (208 alterations), suggesting renovation activity that could disturb asbestos
Riverdale/Fieldston has significant pre-1980s housing stock with known asbestos risk
reporting_angles: Obtain asbestos complaint locations and cross-reference with DOB alteration permits to see if complaints cluster near active construction
Interview DOB about enforcement of asbestos abatement rules during renovations
Contact environmental health advocates to assess whether residents understand testing and remediation rights
